G4533.def:
**Σαλμών**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. שַׂלְמוֹן),
**Salmon**: [[Mat.1.4-5|Mat.1:4-5]], [[Luk.3.32|Luk.3:32]] (Σαλά, WH, R, mg.).†
(AS)

G4524.def:
**Σαδώκ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. צָדוֹק, see supr., see word Σαδδουκαῖος)
**Sadoc, Zadok**: [[Mat.1.14|Mat.1:14]]†
(AS)

G4583.def:
**σεληνιάζω**
(σελήνη),
act, in Manetho (Caren., 4, 81), in NT depon. -ομαι,
to be moonstruck, i.e. epileptic (epilepsy being supposed to be influenced by the moon): [[Mat.4.24; 17.15|Mat.4:24 17:15]].†
(AS)

G4537.def:
**σαλπίζω **
[in LXX chiefly for תָּקַע ;]
**to sound a trumpet**: [[Rev.8.6|Rev.8:6]] ff. [[Rev.9.1, 13; 10.7; 11.15|Rev.9:1, 13 10:7 11:15]]; metaphorically, [[Mat.6.2|Mat.6:2]] Impers., **the trumpet sounds**: [[1Co.15.52|1Co.15:52]]†
(AS)

G4505.def:
**ῥύμη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Isa.15.3|Isa.15:3]] (רְחֹב), [[Pro.31.23|Pro.31:23]] א, [[Tob.13.18|Tob.13:18]], [[Sir.9.7|Sir.9:7]] א1* ;]
1. in cl., the force, rush, swing, of a moving body; esp. of a charge of soldiers.
2. In late Greek (as in Macedonian, see Kennedy, _Sources_, 15), **a narrow road, lane, street**: in Polyb., of a road in camp; in LXX and NT (π. also) of streets in a town, [[Mat.6.2|Mat.6:2]], [[Luk.14.21|Luk.14:21]] [[Act.9.11; 12.10|Act.9:11 12:10]] (cf. Rutherford, _NPhr._, 488).†
(AS)

G4594.def:
**σήμερον** (Att.. τήμερον),
_adv._, [in LXX for יוֹם ;]
**to-day**: [[Mat.6.11|Mat.6:11]], [[Luk.4.21|Luk.4:21]], [[Act.4.9|Act.4:9]], al.; opposite to αὔριον, [[Mat.6.30|Mat.6:30]], [[Luk.12.28|Luk.12:28]], [[Jas.4.13|Jas.4:13]]; χθὲς καὶ σ. καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, [[Heb.13.8|Heb.13:8]] ἡ σ. ἡμέρα, [[Act.20.20|Act.20:20]] ἕως (ἄχρι) τῆς σ. ἡμέρας, [[Rom.11.8|Rom.11:8]], [[2Co.3.14|2Co.3:14]]; μέχρι (ἕως) τῆς σ. (sc. ἡμέρας), [[Mat.11.23; 27.8|Mat.11:23 27:8]]; as subst., τὸ σ., [[Heb.3.13|Heb.3:13]] id. in appos., ὁρίζει ἡμὶραν, σ., [[Heb.4.7|Heb.4:7]] R, mg., (see Westc., in l)
(AS)

G4506.def:
**ῥύομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi., also for גָּאַל, פָּלַט pi., etc. ;]
**to draw to oneself, hence, to rescue, deliver**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]], [[2Pe.2.7|2Pe.2:7]]; id. before ἀπό, [[Mat.6.13|Mat.6:13]], [[Luk.11.4|Luk.11:4]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[2Ti.4.18|2Ti.4:18]] before ἐκ, [[Rom.7.24|Rom.7:24]], [[2Co.1.10|2Co.1:10]], [[Col.1.13|Col.1:13]], [[1Th.1.10|1Th.1:10]], [[2Ti.3.11|2Ti.3:11]], [[2Pe.2.9|2Pe.2:9]]; absol., ὁ ῥυύμενος, the deliverer, [[Rom.11.26|Rom.11:26]] Passive: before ἀπό, [[Rom.15.31|Rom.15:31]], [[2Th.3.2|2Th.3:2]]; before ἐκ, [[Luk.1.74|Luk.1:74]], [[2Ti.4.17|2Ti.4:17]].†
(AS)

G4597.def:
**σής ** σητός (late genitive for cl. σεός), ὁ,
[in LXX: [[Job.4.19|Job.4:19]], [[Isa.50.9|Isa.50:9]] (עָשׁ), [[Isa.51.8|Isa.51:8]] (סָס), al. ;]
**a moth, clothes moth**: [[Mat.6.19-20|Mat.6:19-20]], [[Luk.12.33|Luk.12:33]].†
(AS)

G4550.def:
**σαπρός**, -ά -όν
[in Sm.: [[Lev.27.14, 33|Lev.27:14, 33]] * ;]
**rotten, corrupt, bad, worth­less**: of trees and fruit (opposite to ἀγαθός, καλός), [[Mat.7.17-18; 12.33|Mat.7:17-18 12:33]] [[Luk.6.43|Luk.6:43]]; of fish, [[Mat.13.48|Mat.13:48]]
Metaphorical, in moral sense: λόγος σ., [[Eph.4.29|Eph.4:29]] "In Hellenistic . . . it became a synonym for αἰσχρός or κακός," MM, xxii.†
(AS)

G4541.def:
**Σαμαρείτης**
(-ίτης, Τ; see WH, _App._, 154; BI., § 3, 4), -ον, ό,
a Samaritan, i.e. an inhabitant of the city or the region of Samaria, in NT always the latter (see: Σαμαρία): [[Mat.10.5|Mat.10:5]], [[Luk.9.52; 10.33; 17.16|Luk.9:52 10:33 17:16]], [[Jhn.4.9, 39-40|Jhn.4:9, 39-40]], [[Act.8.25|Act.8:25]]; as an opprobrious epithet, [[Jhn.8.48|Jhn.8:48]]†
(AS)

G4531.def:
**σαλεύω**
(σάλος), [in LXX for מוֹט, זוּעַ, etc. ;]
prop., of the action of wind, storm, etc., **to agitate, shake**: of a reed, [[Mat.11.7|Mat.11:7]], [[Luk.7.24|Luk.7:24]]; a house, [[Luk.6.48|Luk.6:48]], [[Act.4.31; 16.26|Act.4:31 16:26]]; the earth, [[Heb.12.26|Heb.12:26]] the heavenly bodies, [[Mat.24.29|Mat.24:29]], [[Mrk.13.25|Mrk.13:25]], [[Luk.21.26|Luk.21:26]]; of a vessel shaken in filling, [[Luk.6.38|Luk.6:38]] Metaphorical,
(a) to shake, i.e. to render insecure: τὰ σαλευόμενα, τὰ μὴ., [[Heb.12.27|Heb.12:27]]
(b) with accusative of person(s), to cast down from a sense of security and happiness: [[Act.2.25|Act.2:25]] (LXX);
(with) **to unsettle or drive away**: pass., before ἀπὸ τ. νοός, [[2Th.2.2|2Th.2:2]]
(d) **to stir up**: τ. ὄχλους, [[Act.17.13|Act.17:13]]†
(AS)

G4526.def:
**σάκκος ** also written σάκος, -ου, ὁ
(cf. _Heb._ שַׂק, which it renders in LXX),
1. **a coarse cloth, sackcloth, usually made of hair**: [[Rev.6.12|Rev.6:12]]
2. **Anything made of sackcloth**;
(a) a sack ([[Gen.42.25|Gen.42:25]], al.);
(b) **a garment of sackcloth, expressive of mourning or penitence**: [[Mat.11.21|Mat.11:21]], [[Luk.10.13|Luk.10:13]], [[Rev.11.3|Rev.11:3]].†
(AS)

G4570.def:
**σβέννυμι **
[in LXX chiefly for כָּבָה ;]
**of fire or things on fire, to quench**: with accusative, [[Mat.12.20|Mat.12:20]], [[Eph.6.16|Eph.6:16]], [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]]; pass., [[Mat.25.8|Mat.25:8]], [[Mrk.9.48|Mrk.9:48]], [44, 46]. Metaphorical (cf. [[Sng.8.7|Sng.8:7]], [[4Ma.16.4|4Ma.16:4]]): τὸ πνεῦμα, [[1Th.5.19|1Th.5:19]]†
ζβέννυμι, for σβ-, [[1Th.5.19|1Th.5:19]] T (see WH, _Notes_, 148).†
(AS)

G4563.def:
**σαρόω**, -ῶ
late form of σαίρω,
**to sweep**: with accusative, [[Luk.15.8|Luk.15:8]] pass., [[Mat.12.44|Mat.12:44]], [[Luk.11.25|Luk.11:25]].†
(AS)

G4568.def:
**σάτον**, -ου, τό
(Aram. סָאתָא = _Heb._ סְאָה), [in LXX: [[Hag.2.17|Hag.2:17]] (16)* ;]
**a Hebrew measure **(= about a peck and a half): [[Mat.13.33|Mat.13:33]], [[Luk.13.21|Luk.13:21]].†
(AS)

G4522.def:
**σαγήνη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חֵרֶם ;]
**a drag-net, seine**: [[Mat.13.47|Mat.13:47]]†
_SYN._: ἀμφίβληστρον (which see), δίκτυον (AS)

G4576.def:
**σέβω **
[in LXX (chiefly for יָרֵא, [[Jos.4.24|Jos.4:24]], al.) and NT always mid., σέβομαι, exc. [[4Ma.5.24|4Ma.5:24]] ;]
**to worship**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.15.9|Mat.15:9]], [[Mrk.7.7|Mrk.7:7]], [[Act.18.13; 19.27|Act.18:13 19:27]]; σεβόμενος τ. θεόν, [[Act.16.14; 18.7|Act.16:14 18:7]]; σεβόμενοι (σ. προσήλυτοι, σ. Ἕλληνες), devout, [[Act.13.43, 50; 17.4, 17|Act.13:43, 50 17:4, 17]] (cf. προσήλυτος).†
(AS)

G4561.def:
**σάρξ**, σαρκός, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּשָׂר ;]
**flesh**;
1. as in cl. generally,
(a) prop., of the soft substance of the animal body: [[1Co.15.39|1Co.15:39]], [[2Co.12.7|2Co.12:7]], [[Gal.6.13|Gal.6:13]], al.; σ. καὶ αἷμα, [[1Co.5.50|1Co.5:50]] σ. καὶ ὀστέα, [[Luk.24.39|Luk.24:39]] pl., of the flesh of many or parts of the flesh of one (cl.), [[Rev.17.16; 19.18|Rev.17:16 19:18]]; φαγεῖν, Re, ll. with (cf. κατεσθίειν, [[2Ki.9.36|4Ki.9:36]], al., and βιβρώσκειν, frequently in l.); metaphorically, [[Jas.5.3|Jas.5:3]] mystically, φ. (τρώγειν) τὴν σ. τοῦ υἱοῦ τ. ἀνθρώπου, [[Jhn.6.52-56;|Jhn.6:52-56]]
(b) **Of the whole substance of the body, = σῶμα**: [[Act.2.26|Act.2:26]] (LXX), 31, [[2Co.12.7|2Co.12:7]], [[Gal.4.14|Gal.4:14]], [[Eph.5.29|Eph.5:29]]; μία σ., [[Mrk.10.8|Mrk.10:8]] εἰς σ. μίαν ([[Gen.2.24|Gen.2:24]]), [[Mat.19.5|Mat.19:5]], [[Mrk.10.8|Mrk.10:8]], [[1Co.6.16|1Co.6:16]], [[Eph.5.31|Eph.5:31]]; hence, of the material as opposite to the immaterial part of man (cf. Lft., _Notes_, 88): opposite to πνεῦμα, [[1Co.5.5|1Co.5:5]], [[2Co.7.1|2Co.7:1]], [[Col.2.5|Col.2:5]], [[1Pe.3.18; 4.6|1Pe.3:18, 4:6]]; to ψύχη, [[Act.2.31|Act.2:31]], Rec.; of the present life, ἐν (τῇ) σ., [[Rom.7.5|Rom.7:5]], [[Gal.2.20|Gal.2:20]], [[Php.1.22, 24|Php.1:22, 24]] [[1Pe.4.2|1Pe.4:2]]; of Christ's life on earth, αἱ ἡμέραι τ. σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ, [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]] of things pertaining to the body, ἐν (τῇ) σ., [[Gal.6.12, 13|Gal.6:12, 13]] [[Php.3.3|Php.3:3]], 4.
2. As in Heb. idiom,
(a) **of a living creature**: πᾶσα σ. (Heb. כָּל־בָּשָׂר; cf. Bl., §47, 9), [[Mat.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[Mrk.13.20|Mrk.13:20]], [[1Pe.1.24|1Pe.1:24]]; esp. of man and his mortality (Psa.55 (56):5, [[Sir.28.5|Sir.28:5]], al.), [[Jhn.1.14|Jhn.1:14]]; πᾶσα σ. (see supr.), [[Luk.3.6|Luk.3:6]], [[Jhn.17.2|Jhn.17:2]], [[Act.2.17|Act.2:17]], ἐν σ., [[1Jo.4.2|1Jo.4:2]], [[1Ti.3.16|1Ti.3:16]];
(b) of natural origin and relationship ([[Gen.2.24|Gen.2:24]], [[Isa.58.7|Isa.58:7]], al.): τέκνα τῆς σ., [[Rom.9.8|Rom.9:8]] κατὰ σάρκα, ib. 3, 5, [[1Co.10.18|1Co.10:18]], [[Gal.4.23, 29|Gal.4:23, 29]]; ἡ σ. μου, [[Rom.11.14|Rom.11:14]] (cf. [[Jdg.9.2|Jdg.9:2]], [[2Sa.5.1|2Ki.5:1]], al.).
3. Of the physical nature as subject to sensation and desire (Plut.),
(a) **without any ethical disparagement**: [[Rom.7.18; 13.14|Rom.7:18 13:14]]; opposite to πνεῦμα, [[Mat.26.41|Mat.26:41]], [[Mrk.14.38|Mrk.14:38]]; τ. θέλημα τῆς σ., [[Jhn.1.13|Jhn.1:13]] ἡ ἐπιθυμία τῆς σ., [[1Jn.2.16|1Jn.2:16]] pl., [[2Pe.2.18|2Pe.2:18]] παθεῖν σαρκί, [[1Pe.4.1|1Pe.4:1]]
(b) in ethical sense, esp. in Pauline Epp., of the flesh as the seat and vehicle of sinful desires: opposite to νοῦς, [[Rom.7.25|Rom.7:25]] to πνεῦμα, [[Rom.8.4-9, 12, 13|Rom.8:4-9, 12, 13]], [[Gal.5.16, 17, 19; 6.8|Gal.5:16, 17 19 6:8]] (cf. _DB_, ii, 14f.; iv, 165f.; Cremer, 844ff.).
(AS)

G4579.def:
**σείω **
[in LXX chiefly for רָעַשׁ ;]
**to shake, move to and fro**: τ. γῆν, [[Heb.12.26|Heb.12:26]] (LXX); pass., ἡ γῆ, [[Mat.27.51|Mat.27:51]] (LXX); συκῆ, [[Rev.6.13|Rev.6:13]] Metaphorical, **to agitate, stir up, with fear or some other emotion**: [[Mat.21.10; 28.4|Mat.21:10 28:4]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, κατα-σείω).†
(AS)

G4536.def:
**σάλπιγξ**, -ιγγος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹפָר, חֲצֹצְרָה ;]
**a trumpet, used in war and in religious ceremonies**: [[1Co.14.8|1Co.14:8]], [[Heb.12.19|Heb.12:19]], [[Rev.1.10; 4.1; 8.2, 6; 8.11; 9.14|Rev.1:10 4:1 8:2, 6 8:11 9:14]] By meton., **a trumpet blast**: μετὰ σ. μεγάλης, [[Mat.24.31|Mat.24:31]] ἐν σ. θεοῦ, [[1Th.4.16|1Th.4:16]] ἐν τ. ἐσχάτῃ σ., [[1Co.15.52|1Co.15:52]]†
(AS)

G4518.def:
**σαβαχθανεί** (Rec. -νί; ζαφθανεί, Mt, l.with, WH, mg.) (Aram. שְׁבַקְתַּנִי),
sabachthani, i.e. thou host forsaken me: [[Mat.27.46|Mat.27:46]], [[Mrk.15.34|Mrk.15:34]] ([[Psa.22.2|Psa.22:2]], _Heb._ עָזַב).†
**ζαφθανεί** (cf. _Heb._ עָזַב),
**zaphthanei**: [[Mat.27.46|Mat.27:46]] (WH, mg., for Rec. σεβαχθανεί, which see; "probably an attempt to reproduce the _Heb._ as disting from Aram. forms," WE, _Notes_, 21; cf. also Dalman, _Words_, 53 f.).†
(AS)

G4511.def:
**ῥύσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ῥέω), [in LXX chiefly for זוֹב ;]
**a flowing, issue**: τ. αἵματος, [[Mrk.5.25|Mrk.5:25]], [[Luk.8.43-44|Luk.8:43-44]].†
(AS)

G4547.def:
**σανδάλιον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of σάνδαλον, prob. Persian), [in LXX: [[Jos.9.5|Jos.9:5]], [[Isa.20.2|Isa.20:2]] (נָעַל, elsewhere rendered ὑπόδημα, which see), [[Jdt.10.4; 16.9|Jdth.10:4 16:9]] * ;]
**a sandal**: [[Mrk.6.9|Mrk.6:9]], [[Act.12.8|Act.12:8]].†
(AS)

G4501.def:
**ῥομφαία**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חֶרֶב ;]
**a large broad sword, used by the Thracians **(see _DB_, iv, 634); then generally (in LXX used interchangeably with μάχαιρα, which see), **a sword**: [[Rev.1.16; 2.12, 16; 6.8; 19.15, 21|Rev.1:16 2:12, 16 6:8 19:15, 21]]; metaphorically, [[Luk.2.35|Luk.2:35]]†
(AS)

G4527.def:
**Σαλά**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. שֶׁלַח),
**Sala, Shalah**: [[Luk.3.32|Luk.3:32]] (R, txt., Σαλμών, which see), [[Luk.3.35|Luk.3:35]]†
(AS)

G4558.def:
**Σάρεπτα**, -ων (Ob 20), τά (Heb. צָרְפַת),
**Sarepta, a city of Sidon**: [[Luk.4.26|Luk.4:26]]†
(AS)

G4535.def:
**σάλος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for מוֹט, etc. ;]
in poets and late prose, **a tossing**, as of an earthquake; esp. the tossing, the rolling swell of the sea: [[Luk.21.25|Luk.21:25]]†
(AS)

G4530.def:
**Σαλείμ**, τό indecl.,
**Salim**: [[Jhn.3.23|Jhn.3:23]] (see Westc., in l; _DB_, iii, 354).†
(AS)

G4542.def:
**Σαμαρεῖτις (-ῖτις**, T, see supr.), -ιδος, ἡ
1. in FlJ (B.J., i, 21, 2, al.), the region of Samaria.
2. **a Samaritan woman**: [[Jhn.4.9|Jhn.4:9]]†
(AS)

G4591.def:
**σημαίνω**
(σῆμα, a sign), [in LXX for רוּעַ hi., תָּקַע, etc. ;]
**to give a sign, signify, indicate**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.25.27|Act.25:27]], [[Rev.1.1|Rev.1:1]] (cf. MM, xxii); with accusative and inf., [[Act.11.28|Act.11:28]] before quæst. indir., [[Jhn.12.33; 18.32; 21.19|Jhn.12:33 18:32 21:19]].†
(AS)

G4545.def:
**Σαμουήλ**, ὁ indecl.
(in FlJ, Σαμούηλος; _Heb._ שְׁמוּאֵל),
Samuel ([[1Ki.1.20|1Ki.1:20]], al.): [[Act.3.24; 13.20|Act.3:24 13:20]], [[Heb.11.32|Heb.11:32]].†
(AS)

G4549.def:
**Σαούλ**, ὁ indecl.
(in FlJ, Σάουλος; _Heb._ שָׁאוּל)
**Saul**;
(a) **the King of Israel**: [[Act.13.21|Act.13:21]]
(b) the Jewish name of the Apostle Paul, used in the indecl. form only in address (cf. Σαῦλος): [[Act.9.4, 17; 22.7, 13; 26.14|Act.9:4, 17 22:7, 13 26:14]].†
(AS)

G4565.def:
**Σάρων**, -ωνος (accusative -ῶνα, WH), ὁ (Heb. שָׁרוֹן),
**the plain of Sharon**: [[Act.9.35|Act.9:35]]†
(AS)

G4529.def:
**Σαλαμίς**, -ῖνσς, ἡ
**Salamis, the chief city of Cyprus**: [[Act.13.5|Act.13:5]]†
(AS)

G4517.def:
**ῥώννυμι**
[in LXX: [[2Ma.9.20|2Ma.9:20]] [[2Mac.11.21|2Mac 11:21]] [[2Mac.11.28|2Mac 11:28]] [[2Mac.11.33|2Mac 11:33]] [[2Mac.11.1-38|2Mac 11:1-38]]; [[3Ma.6.1-41|3Ma.6:1-41]] * ;]
**to strengthen**; most frequently in pf., ἔρρωμαι, to put forth strength, be strong, hence, often in imperat., ἔρρωσο, ἔρρωσθε, **farewell **(Lat. vale): [[Act.15.29; 23.30|Act.15:29 23:30]] Rec., R, mg.†
(AS)

G4543.def:
**Σαμοθρᾴκη**
(-θράκη, BE), -ης, ἡ
**Samothrace, an island in the Ægean**: [[Act.16.11|Act.16:11]]†
(AS)

G4574.def:
**σέβασμα**, -τος, τό
(σεβάζομαι), [in LXX: [[Wis.14.20; 15.17|Wis.14:20 15:17]], Da TH [[Bel.1.27|Bel 1:27]] * ;]
**an object of worship**: [[Act.17.23|Act.17:23]], [[2Th.2.4|2Th.2:4]].†
(AS)

G4544.def:
**Σάμος**, -ου, ἡ
**Samos, an island in the Ægean**: [[Act.20.15|Act.20:15]]†
(AS)

G4573.def:
**σεβάζομαι**
(σέβας, reverential awe), [in Aq.: [[Hos.10.5|Hos.10:5]] * ;]
1. to fear (Hom).
2. **In later writers, = σέβομαι, to worship**: [[Rom.1.25|Rom.1:25]]
(AS)

G4560.def:
**σάρκινος**, -η, -ον
(σάρξ), [in LXX: [[2Ch.32.8|2Ch.32:8]], [[Ezk.11.19; 36.26|Eze.11:19 36:26]] (בָּשָׂר), [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]], [[Pro.24.23|Pro.24:23]] ([[Pro.29.27|Pro.29:27]]) * ;]
= Lat. carneus (the termination -ινος denoting the substance or material of a thing; see Tr., _Syn._, § LXXii; Lft., _Notes_, 184; and for illustrations from π., see MM, xxii), of the flesh, of flesh, **fleshy **(Plat., Arist., Plut., al.): [[Rom.7.14|Rom.7:14]], [[1Co.3.1|1Co.3:1]], [[2Co.3.3|2Co.3:3]], [[Heb.7.16|Heb.7:16]]. (Rec. has -ικός in all these passages except [[2Co.3.3|2Co.3:3]], but the evidence is decisive against it.)†
_SYN._: σαρκικός, q.v (AS)

G4519.def:
**σαβαώθ ** indecl.,
[in LXX for צָבָא, chiefly in Isaiah (in other places, the phrase is also rendered by κύριος παντοκράτωρ, κ. τῶν δυνάμεων; see _DB_, iii, 137 f.) ;]
Sabaoth, i.e. hosts or armies (see _DB_, l.with): [[Rom.9.29|Rom.9:29]] (LXX), Ja 54.†
(AS)

G4559.def:
**σαρκικός**, -ή, -όν (σάρξ)
(seel. for σάρκινος, Arist., H.A., x, 2, 7)
= Lat. carnalis, i.e.
(a) **associated with or pertaining to the flesh, fleshly, carnal**: [[Rom.15.27|Rom.15:27]], [[1Co.9.11|1Co.9:11]];
(b) **in a more ethical sense, of the nature of the flesh, under the control of its appetites, fleshly, carnal, sensual **(but including more than mere sensuality; cf. Hort, 1Pe., 133): [[1Co.3.3|1Co.3:3]], [[2Co.1.12; 10.4|2Co.1:12 10:4]], [[1Pe.2.11|1Pe.2:11]].†
_SYN._: σάρκινος (which see), ψυχικός; cf. Tr., _Syn._, §§ LXXi, LXXii; Lft., _Notes_, 184 f.; Vau. on [[Rom.7.14|Rom.7:14]] (AS)

G4553.def:
**σαργάνη**, -ης, ἡ
1. a plaited rope (Æsch.).
2. **a hamper, a basket made of ropes**: [[2Co.11.33|2Co.11:33]]†
(AS)

G4512.def: **a fold ** or **pucker ** in the face, **a wrinkle **, Lat. _ruga_, (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

G4586.def:
**σεμνός**, -ή, -όν
(σέβομαι), [in LXX: [[Pro.6.8; 8.6; 15.26|Pro.6:8 8:6 15:26]], [[2Ma.6.11|2Ma.6:11]] [[2Mac.6.28|2Mac 6:28]] [[2Mac.8.15|2Mac 8:15]], [[4Ma.5.36|4Ma.5:36]] [[4Mac.7.15|4Mac 7:15]] [[4Mac.17.5|4Mac 17:5]] * ;]
1. reverend, august, venerable, in cl. of the gods and also of human beings.
2. **grave, serious; of persons**: [[1Ti.3.8; 3.11|1Ti.3:8 3:11]], [[Tit.2.2|Tit.2:2]]; of things: [[Php.4.8|Php.4:8]] (see Tr., _Syn._, § xcii; Cremer, 37; MM, xxii).†
(AS)

G4525.def:
**σαίνω **
1. prop. (Hom., al.), of dogs, to wag the tail, fawn.
2. Metaphorical, of persons, with accusative, **to fawn upon, flatter, beguile**: pass., [[1Th.3.3|1Th.3:3]] (for conjectural emendations of the text, see _ICC_, and M, _Th._, in l).†
(AS)

G4593.def:
**σημειόω**, -ῶ
(σημεῖον), [in LXX: [[Psa.4.6|Psa.4:6]] (נָשָׂא)* ;]
to mark, note. Mid., **to note for oneself**: [[2Th.3.14|2Th.3:14]] (frequently in π.; see _ICC_, M, _Th._, in l).†
(AS)

G4587.def:
**σεμνότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(σεμνός), [in LXX: [[2Ma.3.12|2Ma.3:12]] * ;]
**gravity**: [[1Ti.2.2; 3.4|1Ti.2:2 3:4]] (Vg. eastitas, cf. Soph., _Lex._, and Zorell, see word), [[Tit.2.7|Tit.2:7]]†
(AS)

G4520.def:
**σαββατισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(σαββατίζω, to keep the sabbath, [[Exo.16.30|Exo.16:30]], al.),
**a keeping sabbath, a sabbath rest**: metaphorically, as in Mishna (Zorell, see word), [[Heb.4.9|Heb.4:9]]†
(AS)

G4508.def:
**ῥυπαρός**, -ά, -όν
(ῥύπος), [in LXX: [[Zec.3.4-5|Zec.3:4-5]], (3-4) (צוֹא)* ;]
**filthy, dirty**: of old, shabby clothing (Za, l.with), [[Jas.2.2|Jas.2:2]] metaphorically, of moral defilement, [[Rev.22.11|Rev.22:11]]†
(AS)

G4595.def:
**σήπω **
[in LXX; [[Psa.38.5|Psa.38:5]] (מָקַק ni.), [[Job.33.21|Job.33:21]] (כָּלָה) [[Job.40.7|Job.40:7]], [[Sir.14.19|Sir.14:19]], al. ;]
**to make corrupt**: 2 pf. act, with mid, sense (see M, _Pr._, 154), σέσηπεν, has perished, become corrupted, [[Jas.5.2|Jas.5:2]]†
(AS)

G4577.def:
**σειρά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Jdg.16.13-14, 19|Jdg.16:13-14, 19]] (מַחְלָפָה), [[Pro.5.22|Pro.5:22]] (חֶבֶל) * ;]
1. (a) a cord;
(b) **a chain **(cf. _Pr._, l.with): σειραὶ ζόφου, [[2Pe.2.4|2Pe.2:4]], Rec., R, mg. (see: σειρός).
2. a lock of hair (Jg, ll. with).†
(AS)

G4500.def:
**ῥοιζηδόν **
_adv._ (ῥοῖζος, the whistling of an arrow),
**with rushing sound **(as of roaring flames): [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]]†
(AS)

G4554.def:
**Σάρδεις**, -εων, αἱ
**Sardis, the chief city of Lydia**: [[Rev.1.11; 3.1, 4|Rev.1:11 3:1, 4]]
(AS)

G4556.def:
**σάρδιον**, -ον, τ
[in LXX for אֹדֶם, [[Exo.28.17|Exo.28:17]], al.; also for שֹׁהַם ;]
**the sardian stone, sard **(of which carnelian is one variety): [[Rev.4.3; 21.20|Rev.4:3 21:20]].†
(AS)

G4596.def:
**σιρικός** (by assimilation of vowels, for σηρικός; see Mayser, 150; WH, _Notes_, 151), -ή, -όν
(οἱ Σῆρες, a people of India from whom the ancients got the first silk),
**silk, silken**; as subst., τὸ σ., **silken fabric, silk**: [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]] (cf. FlJ, B.J., vii, 5, 4).†
(AS)

G4585.def:
**σεμίδαλις**, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for סֹלֶת ;]
**fine wheaten flour**: [[Rev.18.13|Rev.18:13]]†
(AS)

G4538.def:
**σαλπιστής**
(so Inscr. and late writers for Mt. σαλπιγκτής), οῦ, ὁ,
**a trumpeter**: [[Rev.18.22|Rev.18:22]]†
(AS)

G4552.def:
**σάπφειρος**, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for סַפִּיר ;]
**sapphire **(perh. = lapis lazuli): [[Rev.21.19|Rev.21:19]]†
(AS)

G4557.def:
**σαρδόνυξ** (L, σαρδιόνυξ), -υχος, ὁ
(σάρδιον, ὄνυξ),
**sardonyx, a stone marked by the red of the sard and the white of the onyx**: [[Rev.21.20|Rev.21:20]]†
(AS)

G4510.def:
**ῥυπόω**, -ῶ
(ῥύπος),
**to make filthy**: [[Rev.22.11|Rev.22:11]] Rec. (AV, tr. as = ῥυπάω, to be filthy).†
(AS)
